name: citybik
description: CityBikes (citybik.es) collects open bike-sharing data from around the world. This CLI queries the public CityBikes API (api.citybik.es/v2) for networks, network details and live station availability, and lists the projects showcased as built on CityBikes.

commands.name: list-networks
commands.summary: List all bike-sharing networks worldwide, with id, name, city, country, operating company and API href

params.name: api_fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of network fields to return, which keeps the response small. Available fields: id, name, location, href, company, gbfs_href, system, source (sent to the site as "fields"; clify's own --fields only shapes the output)

commands.name: get-network
commands.summary: Get details of one bike-sharing network by id (name, location, company, GBFS feed, system), without the station list

params.name: network_id
params.description: Network id (slug) as returned by list-networks, e.g. velib, bicing

commands.name: list-network-stations
commands.summary: List the live stations of a bike-sharing network, with available bikes, empty docks, coordinates and last update time

params.name: network_id
params.description: Network id (slug) as returned by list-networks, e.g. bicing, velib

commands.name: list-projects
commands.summary: List the apps and projects that the CityBikes showcase page lists as built on CityBikes data

notes: All network data comes from the public, unauthenticated CityBikes API at https://api.citybik.es/v2. No login is needed.

list-networks returns every network (several hundred), and the API has no server-side search or pagination. Use --fields (e.g. id,name,location) to shrink the payload, then filter on location.city or location.country client-side to find a network id.

Station data is live. free_bikes is the number of bikes available to rent, and empty_slots is the number of free docks to return a bike. Some stations also carry an 'extra' object (e.g. ebikes, address), which you can request via --fields on the raw output.
The city search box on the homepage map did not load during exploration and sent no API calls, so it has no command. Use list-networks instead.
